overview.description: The BNY Mellon Active Core Bond ETF (BKFI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed, seeking high total returns through a fixed-income portfolio of US government securities and global corporate bonds rated as investment-grade. Securities may be of any maturity or duration BKFI was launched on Jan 12, 2026 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
